title: Function coverage for Read Input Registers
purpose: Add missing public function coverage for function 0x04 with a simple valid register-read request.
expected_behavior: Server should parse the request as Read Input Registers starting at address 0x0000 for quantity 0x0002 and return register values or an exception.
constraints_preserved: length is 0x0006 for unit_id plus 5-byte function 0x04 PDU.
Function code 0x04 is used for Read Input Registers.
Request uses starting address followed by quantity of registers.
issue_safety_notes: This valid seed broadens read-side coverage without introducing malformed fields.
